content.title: Asymptotic isoperimetry for parallelohedra
content.abstract: The smallest possible surface area of a convex translational tile of $\mathbb R^n$ approaches $\sqrt{2}$ times that of a ball of equal volume as $n\to\infty$. For the lower bound, we combine Gaussian smoothing with the Milman-Neeman multi-bubble theorem. For the upper bound, we use Siegel mean value theorem to average over lattice Voronoi cells. Our method also yields convex $\mathbb Z^n$-tiles whose orthogonal projection onto any hyperplane has volume $O(\sqrt{\log n})$, answering a question of Naor and Regev.
